sourceIdea: Davies presents ordinary participation as connection, contribution, responsibility, movement, language, sequences and independence. Tasks take longer, require supervision and have imperfect results. Keep it enjoyable, stop before overwhelm, limit quantities to what can be cleaned up, keep cleanup tools together, and use what is at home. Under2s likely begin with one or two steps; add steps with mastery. Her statements about calming children and becoming lifelong helpers are author expectations, not guaranteed outcomes.
